lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: // Fills in every instance's layout from its props; a Text is as large as its lines. Roots, and children of a Rect,

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: // sit at their own x/y, except that each Text child of a Rect sits one line lower for every Text child before it.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: // A Stack or Scroll flows its children along its direction: a child's main-axis coordinate is a leading margin, its

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: // cross-axis coordinate an offset from the aligned position.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: // A Scroll that is the last child and has no main-axis size fills the rest of a parent with a stated one.
